site: Workday (any 'Country Phone Code' style search-driven single-choice list)
class: A reader of a widget's value looked in one place only, so a widget that keeps its value elsewhere always read as empty
symptom: The agent re-answered the Country Phone Code field on every pass and handed over with 'could not set' (Stryker, 23 September).
root_cause: _multiselect_selection read only the selected-item pill. A search-driven single-choice list keeps its committed value in a sibling 'items selected' listbox while its input stays empty, so the field read as empty forever.
why_tests_missed: Every synthetic multiselect in the tests rendered a pill.
fix: The reader falls back to the 'items selected' listbox, then to the widget's visually-hidden summary text, and strips the 'press delete to clear value' suffix.
prevention: Read a widget's state from every place the widget family is known to keep it, and test with each rendering, not just the common one.
